text: Ironvale Athletic's 5-3-2 setup with a low block and deep defensive line effectively absorbed Redmond Rovers' high press and quick circulation. Their direct, vertical passing created 4 final third entries and 3 shots with an xG of 0.84 in just 8 minutes, allowing them to seize control despite possessing only 43.8% in the last 10 minutes [#1133] [#1066] [#1157]. Redmond’s high defensive line left them vulnerable to counters, culminating in Jonah Lindqvist’s goal at 61’ from a high-quality chance (xG 0.74) [#1157]. The key coaching point is to instruct players on managing space behind a high defensive line against teams proficient in quick vertical transitions to prevent such counter-attacking threats.
